sourceRoleBoundaries.official_announcements: A supplier-owned or explicitly attributed issuer announcement belongs to this role only with exact issuer/product scope. A historical story does not establish a complete recurring index.
sourceRoleBoundaries.investor_acquirer: The investor or acquirer must itself support the exact subject relationship. A supplier naming an investor, portfolio repost or another deal does not establish recurring counterparty coverage.
sourceRoleBoundaries.release_distribution: A wire distributor or paid syndicated issuer release is a distribution lead. Publisher carriage does not make it independent editorial reporting.
sourceRoleBoundaries.independent_reporting: Requires actual independent editorial reporting about this supplier. Supplier-owned Industry News, Tracxn data profiles and paid release syndication do not prove this role.
sourceRoleBoundaries.regulatory_filings: An explicitly bound parent issuer index may support a historical source proposal. Parent financial numbers and events cannot be assigned to a product or segment from a company link alone.
sourceRoleBoundaries.filing_documents: Requires the exact issuer, a complete eligible-document selection, retained readable bodies and source qualification. Historical parent documents do not add a current segment check.
